stream.description: To start a stream, first click on the 'Add' button.
stream.title: Starting a Stream

watch.description: Streams that are currently running on the server will be displayed in a list on the home page. To start watching, first click on the desired stream on the list. Note: Clicking on the '▶' symbol is a quick way to directly start watching.
watch.title: Watching a Stream

welcome.description: Media MTX is a streaming service that allows you to create and watch video streams.
welcome.title: Welcome to MediaMTX!

opentak0.description: OpenTAK_ICU will be provided to android devices after having connected to a TAK server. You can autoimport settings to OpenTAK_ICU. After importing you will be able to start a stream.
opentak0.title: Auto importing settings

opentak1.description: You can import settings manually if needed. Click on the gear icon to open settings.
opentak1.title: Starting a Stream Manually - Step 1

opentak2.description: Click on 'Streaming Settings' to open the streaming settings.
opentak2.title: Starting a Stream Manually - Step 2

opentak3.description: From step 1, copy over the values for 'Username', 'Password', 'Protocol', 'Address', 'Port' and 'Path' to the OpenTAK ICU settings. You can now start
opentak3.title: Starting a Stream Manually - Step 3

stream1.description: To begin a stream with OpenTAK ICU, expand the 'OpenTAK ICU' menu. This menu has all the information necessary to start a stream in the app.
stream1.title: Starting a Stream

watch1.description: To watch the stream, click on the 'Open in Browser' button. More options are listed under 'Advanced Links', which can be opened with e.g. VLC.
watch1.title: Watching a Stream
